name: The uuid mix census, one quantum seal: the directed census doubles the 45 pairs (10·9 = 2·45 — merge(a,b) ≠ merge(b,a), so both directions count, verified live as 90 distinct addresses); the 10 self-mixes complete the square (90 + 10 = 10²); and Pascal's row 10 — the mixes of every size, 1 empty through 1 total fusion — folds to exactly 1024, the 10-qubit lattice (dimension sealed as optimisation_space_is_qubit_dimension, cited not re-sealed). Three counts, one conjunction: the mix space is a qubit basis counted whole.
